title: Memory, Context Management, and Long Conversations
description: Keep long conversations coherent and affordable without blowing the context window.
learningOutcomes: Summarize history without losing important facts
Design conversation memory that survives restarts

lessons.title: Context Windows and Truncation
lessons.description: What happens when a conversation gets too long, and how to plan for it.
learningObjectives: Estimate token usage of a conversation

lessons.title: Summarizing History
lessons.description: Compress old turns into a summary instead of discarding them.
learningObjectives: Summarize a conversation to save tokens
Decide what must never be summarized away
Refresh a summary as a conversation continues

lessons.title: Persistent Memory Across Sessions
lessons.description: Remember facts about a user between separate conversations.
learningObjectives: Store durable facts outside the chat transcript
Retrieve relevant memory at the start of a session
Handle memory that becomes stale or wrong

lessons.title: Cost and Latency Budgets
lessons.description: Treat tokens like a resource with a budget, not an afterthought.
learningObjectives: Estimate cost per request at scale
Trade off model size against latency and cost

assignment.title: Assignment: A Long-Conversation Memory Manager
assignment.description: Build a conversation manager with token-budgeted truncation, pinned facts, rolling summarization, cross-session persistent memory with staleness handling, and cost tracking.
learningObjectives: Combine truncation, summarization, and persistent memory into one system
Retrieve relevant cross-session memory at the start of a new conversation
Track and report token cost per session
